key.name: scrolling-capture
key.summary: Scrolling capture of the focused window
key.description: Keybinding to start a scroll-and-stitch capture of the currently focused window. The whole window content is scrolled and the frames are stitched into one tall PNG saved under ~/Imagens/BigShot/.

key.name: forensic-capture
key.description: Keybinding that opens a modal prompting for a URL and then produces a forensic evidence bundle (full-page PNG, MHTML, HAR, TLS chain, hashes, optional RFC 3161 timestamp) via the Python helper at /usr/lib/big-shot/forensic_capture.py.
